name: jaml-language-support
description: Motely.Lsp (engine diagnostics/hover/completion) + @jimbo chat participant for JAML seed filters.

chatParticipants.name: jimbo
chatParticipants.description: JAML filters, Motely search, Balatro seed hunt

commands.name: find
commands.description: Search seeds for the active or attached JAML (J2 wires Motely)

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate JAML with the Motely engine

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Explain a clause or must/should chain

disambiguation.description: The user wants help with JAML filters, Motely, Balatro seed search, or Jimbo Ante Markup Language.
examples: find a seed for this jaml filter
what does voucher Overstock mean in jaml
search balatro seeds with perkeo ante 1

languageModelTools.name: motely_validate_jaml
languageModelTools.userDescription: Validate JAML with the Motely engine loader
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Parse and validate a JAML Balatro seed filter with the real Motely engine (JamlConfigLoader via Motely.Lsp --diagnose). Use before search. Returns OK or a table of errors with line/column. Prefer absolute filePath to an open .jaml, or pass full jamlText. Do not invent diagnostics.

jamlText.description: Full JAML document text when not reading a file

filePath.description: Absolute path to a .jaml file on disk

jaml.serverPath.description: Absolute path to the Motely.Lsp executable. Empty = bundled server/Motely.Lsp, else workspace `dotnet run --project Motely.Lsp`.

jaml.trace.server.description: Trace Motely.Lsp ↔ VS Code communication in the Output panel.
